name: Bottle Sort
description: Pour coloured liquid between bottles until each one holds a single colour.
author: Koda Learning Lab
tagline: Plan the pours, and sort every bottle.

features.name: Spoken voice
features.description: Reads the lesson opening, the hint line and the reason a pour was refused.

features.name: Sound chimes
features.description: Plays the pour, refusal and solved sounds.

features.name: Haptic feedback
features.description: Pairs a pour and a refusal with device feedback.

features.name: Pouring animation
features.description: Tips the bottle and draws the stream. Off pours instantly; the result is the same either way.

features.name: Move hints
features.description: Offers a strategy nudge, then names a bottle that has somewhere to go.

features.name: Step framing tags
features.description: Labels warm-up, challenge and milestone steps.

features.name: Charge for later lessons
features.description: Keeps a configurable number of lessons free.

settingsSchema.label: Final tag
settingsSchema.help: Optional wording for the final step.

settingsSchema.label: Free lessons
settingsSchema.help: Number of lessons available before a plan is needed.
